settings.heading: Help and FAQ
settings.text: Answers to the questions we are asked most.

settings.question: Where do you deliver?
settings.answer: To addresses in the United Kingdom. Delivery options and prices for your address are shown at checkout before you pay. See Delivery.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: We email you tracking details when your parcel leaves us. You can also check any order on the Track an order page using your order number and email address.

settings.question: My order arrived damaged. What should I do?
settings.answer: Keep the packaging, take a photo and contact us. We will arrange a replacement or a refund.

settings.question: Can I return something if I change my mind?
settings.answer: Yes. You can cancel for any reason up to 14 days after your order arrives, then send the items back within 14 days of telling us. See Returns and refunds.

settings.question: When will I get my refund?
settings.answer: Within 14 days of us receiving the goods back, or of you sending us proof that you have returned them. Refunds go to your original payment method.

settings.question: What is a pre-order?
settings.answer: An item you can order before it arrives in our warehouse. It is marked “Pre-order” on the product page, in your basket and at checkout, and is sent once it arrives with us. See Pre-orders.

settings.question: Can I cancel a pre-order?
settings.answer: Yes, for a full refund, at any time before it is sent.

settings.question: Can I use indoor lights outside?
settings.answer: No. Only use lights outdoors if the product page says they are rated for outdoor use.

settings.question: How do I store an artificial tree?
settings.answer: Pack it clean and dry in its original box or a tree storage bag, and keep it somewhere cool and dry. See Care and assembly.

settings.question: How can I pay?
settings.answer: The payment methods available for your order are shown at checkout. Card payments are processed securely by Stripe; we never see or store your full card details.
